overview: This one-page Department of State list of papers concerns freight rates affecting Japan and records two Nagoya submissions relating to joint tariffs issued by the Trans-Pacific Freight Conference of Japan and the Japan–Atlantic Coast Freight Conference. The first entry identifies Joint Tariff No. 10, effective September 1, 1934, while the second records Addendum No. 3 to Joint Freight Tariff No. 11, containing corrections and changes to the current tariff in January 1936. The sheet also supplies cross-references to other filing locations.

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on freight rates in Japan
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes two Nagoya papers concerning joint freight tariffs for shipping between Japan and trans-Pacific and Atlantic Coast destinations.
subfiles.summary: The first entry records Nagoya paper no. 121 from Newton, dated September 10, concerning Joint Tariff No. 10 of the Trans-Pacific Freight Conference of Japan and the Japan-Atlantic Coast Freight Conference, effective September 1, 1934, with a cross-reference to file 800.8870. The second records Nagoya paper no. 42 from Stephan, dated January 4, 1936, transmitting page 1 of Addendum No. 3 to Joint Freight Tariff No. 11, which embodied corrections and changes to the current tariff. That entry refers the reader to 195/1688.

interest: The sheet is useful as a compact guide to records that may otherwise be filed elsewhere, preserving connections among State Department decimal files and consular submissions from Nagoya. It documents the administrative machinery through which Japanese trans-Pacific and Atlantic Coast shipping conferences revised and circulated freight tariffs during the mid-1930s. Although it contains no tariff schedules itself, its precise tariff, addendum, effective-date, and cross-reference information can help historians reconstruct changes in interwar maritime pricing and locate related documents.
